question: Related Questions Q. Is Income or commission of insurance advisor is halaal or haram? 6699 views Q. Now the court has ordered me to pay compensation (on which they have charged interest) to the non muslim labourers who worked there.Since my financial position is not very good, I would like to ask whether i can pay this amount from the bank interest that has accumalated in my bank account or out of zakaat? Interest 1721 views Q. Interest @ Insurance 1714 views Q. business 1818 views Q. Regarding joining a company 1926 views Q. My questions are as below Q1. I lend the house loan for getting rebate in the income tax, and i am paying the intrest to the bank. In the light of the Saharia, what is the islamic aspect of this investment. If it is not allowed then what is the ways so that i may come out cleanly. Q 2- I invested in NSC ( National security certificate) issued by the post office, it make doubble your amount in 7~8 years and i also get the income tax rebate as per law 80-c. Is return of that is allowed to use. Q3i have purchased the car that is partially bank financed. What is islamic aspect. 1963 views Q. Legal method of buying car through bank 4319 views Q. I was not aware of the prohibition of interest and gravity of its "hurmat". I came to Mumbai from Lucknow and started working in a Call Centre, I did not have my own house so I bought one by taking loan from a Bank. Now I realise the ill effects and evil of interest, I want to sell off that house and get rid of interest. I paid approximately Rs.1,30,000 out of my own pocket and got a loan of Rs.6,80,000, the house cost in all approximately Rs.8,10,000. Now I want to sell off that house, it may fetch around Rs.13 lakhs today. I want to know how much can I keep and how much will be the interest which I should not use. Please let me know out of the sale price how much will be HALAL for me and what percentage will be HARAM for me? Also let me know what could be the possible ways of disposing the HARAM amount. 1761 views Q. Fix Profit 3315 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 1133 Country: MY Title: Please could you inform me as to what is the ruling on Takaful (Islamic Insurance / Cooperative Insurance in Islam). Previously I sympathised this mode of insurance, though recent correspondence I obtained from the Ulama of Darul Iftaa, Camperdown, South Africa imply that it is Haraam. Maybe I did not understand properly. I would be greatful if you could advice me of the ruling, and please could you explain as to the reasons on why it is Haram or Halal. In Malaysia, I am among a handful of Traditionalist Ahlus Sunnah Wal Jama'ah adherents who want to know what our Fuqaha say. In Malaysia, we have many scholars too, but it is greatly influenced by the "Modern" school. Traditionalism is not strong in Malaysia. Question: From: Ezrin Zahari To: Muftis and the Ulama at Darul Uloom Deoband Assalaamu'alaikum to all - my dearest and most respected Muftis and Ulama at Darul Uloom Deoband. May Allah SWT protect you. I hope you are in the best of health. InshaAllah. I am emailing from Malaysia. Alhamdulillah, I have now obtained your contact after so long searching for it. I have two questions, please help me: QUESTION 1 Please could you inform me as to what is the ruling on Takaful (Islamic Insurance / Cooperative Insurance in Islam). Previously I sympathised this mode of insurance, though recent correspondence I obtained from the Ulama of Darul Iftaa, Camperdown, South Africa imply that it is Haraam. Maybe I did not understand properly. I would be greatful if you could advice me of the ruling, and please could you explain as to the reasons on why it is Haram or Halal. In Malaysia, I am among a handful of Traditionalist Ahlus Sunnah Wal Jama'ah adherents who want to know what our Fuqaha say. In Malaysia, we have many scholars too, but it is greatly influenced by the "Modern" school. Traditionalism is not strong in Malaysia. QUESTION 2 Please could you inform me as to whether the following schemes provided in the following website is Halal. It is by Prudential BSN Takaful Malaysia: http://www.prubsn.com.my/products_services.php The products are "General Takaful", and "Family Takaful". Please could you tell me as to whether these mechanisms are Halal or not. May Allah Ta'ala reward you immensely for your service to Mankind. Ameen. JazakamullahuKhairan Katheera! Answer ID: 1133 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 545/534=N) We do not knwo what Islamic insurance is and what are its functions and rules. Is it like insurance prevalent in India or is it different? Please, describe in detail so that we can have a say in the matter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
